articles.title: Hackers Use ConnectWise SkyKick Credentials to Access Microsoft 365, Halting Cloud Backups
articles.summary:
Attackers abused compromised ConnectWise Cloud Backup credentials to access Microsoft 365 customer environments, prompting ConnectWise to shut off application access and interrupt backup services. Jonathan Semon confirmed unauthorized sign-ins across 162 tenants as of 19:00 UTC on October 16, exposing risks associated with privileged vendor applications.
